notes: Machine-readable rules data for exact Chronicle references and prerequisite validation. Entries are expanded only from verified Saga Edition rules sources.

rules.name: Devastating Attack
rules.description: Choose a single Exotic Weapon or weapon group with which you are proficient. Whenever you make a successful attack against a target using that weapon, treat the target's Damage Threshold as 5 points lower when determining the result of the attack.

special: Proficient with selected Exotic Weapon or weapon group

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Weapon Specialist Talent Tree

rules.name: Weapon Specialization
rules.description: Choose a single Exotic Weapon or weapon group with which you are proficient. You gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls with the selected weapon or weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected Exotic Weapon or weapon group

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Weapon Specialist Talent Tree

rules.name: Knack
rules.description: Once per day, you can reroll a skill check and take the better result. You can select this talent multiple times; each time you select it, you can use it one additional time per day.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Fortune Talent Tree

rules.name: Acute Senses
rules.description: You may reroll any Perception check, but you must keep the result of the reroll even if it is worse.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Awareness Talent Tree

rules.name: Improved Initiative
rules.description: You may reroll any Initiative check, but you must keep the result of the reroll even if it is worse.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Awareness Talent Tree

rules.name: Indomitable
rules.description: Once per day as a swift action, move +5 steps on the condition track. This does not remove persistent conditions that prevent movement up the condition track.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Commando Talent Tree

rules.name: Block
rules.description: As a reaction, you may negate a melee attack by making a Use the Force check. The DC equals the result of the attack roll you wish to negate. You must have a drawn and ignited lightsaber and be aware of the attack.

special: Drawn and ignited lightsaber required to use the talent

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Lightsaber Combat Talent Tree

rules.name: Point Blank Shot
rules.description: You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls with ranged weapons against targets within point-blank range.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Point Blank Shot

rules.name: Dodge
rules.description: You gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense against attacks made by one opponent you designate. You may designate a new opponent on your turn.

rules.name: Skill Training
rules.description: Choose one untrained skill from your class skill list. You become trained in that skill.

special: Selected skill must be a class skill and not already trained

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Skill Training

rules.name: Skill Focus
rules.description: Choose one trained skill. You gain a +5 competence bonus on checks made with that skill.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Skill Focus

rules.name: Force Sensitivity
rules.description: You become Force-sensitive, may make Use the Force checks, and gain access to Force talents when you are eligible to select a talent.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Force Sensitivity

rules.name: Force Training
rules.description: You add a number of Force powers to your Force power suite equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). You may select this feat multiple times; each selection adds another set of powers.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Force Training
